selection: Seed0 is the adaptive calibration selection seed. Freeze one accepted pure configuration only after its existing joint seed0 target is met; then train seeds1/2 from scratch and retain both outcomes without reranking seeds or changing the incumbent.
frozen_identity: Native API recipe fields, selected count-generator/critic/feature/optimizer/update/scorer source closure, architecture, total fixed update endpoint, pure generation with zero real-bag replacements, fitting donors and transforms, calibration cohort and fixed per-seed query/library traces. Training seed and the explicitly predeclared seed-derived streams are the varying factor.
freeze_proof: Require accepted independently recomputed seed0 evidence, complete checkpoint hash, clean native completion/release/accounting settlement, exact source pins, current pure incumbent hash and all three matched baseline hashes. A replay-only incumbent requires an explicit verified original fitting-lineage bridge before freezing.

stable_target.mean_energy_score: Mean ES across all three seeds at least5percent below the mean of their matched resampling ES values.
stable_target.per_seed: Each seed has strictly lower ES and no greater cell energy distance than its matched resampling baseline.
stable_target.spread: Each total donor spread ratio within[0.7,1.3].
stable_target.validity: All fixed endpoints complete, pure count contracts and complete source/checkpoint/array bindings independently verified; owned cleanup and canonical charges settled.

admission: A freeze creates no GPU lease or native deployment. Extend and qualify the exact source binding for the frozen seeds before any native confirmation; retain all existing resource, peer, deadline and accounting guards. No automatic restart or successor.
scope: Same four adaptive calibration donors, not twelve independent donors. Evaluation donors remain outside model/seed ranking. No external SOTA or independent biological confirmation claim.
